key_claims.claim: ACOG guideline consolidates cerclage indications, techniques, and management using modified GRADE, clarifying which patients benefit from cerclage versus progesterone alone.
Thyroid function trajectories in subclinical hypothyroidism and hypothyroxinemia vary by TPO antibody status through pregnancy and one year postpartum.
Continuous spline modeling of pre-pregnancy BMI reveals nonlinear, outcome-specific risk relationships, with categorical thresholds underestimating risk at extremes.
Higher-rate postpartum oxytocin infusion reduces median quantitative blood loss compared to lower rates after vaginal birth.
Prior severe preeclampsia, HELLP, or eclampsia confers approximately 15% recurrence risk in subsequent pregnancy, with earlier index delivery predicting higher recurrence.
